# US Power-Demand Forecast Cut After Texas Pause on Data Centers

A power generating station outside of Austin, Texas. Photographer: Jordan Vonderhaar/Bloomberg

By Will Wade

September 9, 2026 at 1:35 PM EDT

US electricity consumption is expected to grow more slowly after Texas paused the development of new power-hungry data centers. 

Total electricity sales are forecast to rise 1.8% in 2027 from this year, according to government figures released Wednesday, down from the 2.9% growth projected in August.
